verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at inference-docs.cerebras.ai/llms.txt that indexes the docs as Markdown pages. Each Markdown page also tells agents to fetch the complete documentation index from llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-docs guidance beyond the index, and no published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/llms.txt # Cerebras Inference
